paper_title: MICROSCOPE mission: first constraints on the violation of the weak equivalence principle by a light scalar dilaton
coupling_convention: dimensionless alpha (Yukawa strength relative to gravity), q=B coupling
notes: Paper constrains composition-dependent scalar fifth force via WEP test (Eotvos parameter). Two main cases: q=B (baryon number, ScalarBaryon, |alpha|<1e-11) and q=B-L (VectorBL-like, |alpha|<1e-12). Reported limit is for B coupling per hint. Constraints given as exclusion contours in (alpha, lambda) plane (Figs 1-2), not numerical tables; values extracted from text plateau at |alpha|<1e-11 for m_phi<1e-12 eV. Mass-range relation: lambda=hbar/(m_phi c). 2-sigma (95% CL). Could also be classified as ScalarNucleon (Yukawa fifth force) or VectorBL (B-L case); ambiguity lowers confidence.
